notes: Printed Transmogrify: 'Exile target creature. That creature's controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles the rest into their library.' Cast from the act menu as a dealt game casts it: one target question (the Bull), and no player question: 'that creature's controller' is not a target. Seat 1 reveals Top Sorcery, then Second Card, the first creature card, which enters under seat 1's control (CR 110.2a); Top Sorcery is shuffled back and Deep Creature was never revealed. Before the fix the tree read TARGET_PLAYER (the menu asked a second, player target) and searched only the library's top card, so a noncreature on top put nothing onto the battlefield.
